title: The Phone Doctor
summary: The audience voted FIX. He spends part of the money on a cheap repair kit, sets up a tiny phone-repair corner on a bench, fixes three phones and earns his first real customers. A woman offers him a spot in her shop if he can fix a tablet nobody else could.

scenes.image_prompt: Morning at the train station, he reads comments on a cracked phone screen with a huge smile, golden morning light
scenes.caption: You chose FIX.
scenes.narration: You chose fix. And you sent me five hundred and eighty two dollars. I couldn't sleep.

scenes.image_prompt: He buys a small repair toolkit at a street market stall, holding it proudly
scenes.caption: First investment.
scenes.narration: First, a real repair kit. Forty dollars. My first investment.

scenes.image_prompt: He sits at a park bench with a handwritten cardboard sign, repairing a phone, people waiting
scenes.caption: Phone doctor is open.
scenes.narration: A cardboard sign, a bench, and suddenly I'm the phone doctor of the park.

scenes.image_prompt: An old lady hugs her repaired phone happily while he smiles
scenes.caption: Best customer ever.
scenes.narration: She cried when her grandson's photos came back. She paid me double.

scenes.image_prompt: A stylish shop owner hands him a broken tablet in front of a small electronics shop at sunset
scenes.caption: A real shop?
scenes.narration: Then a shop owner said: fix this tablet, and you get a spot in my shop.

vote.title: Take the deal?
vote.narration: Do I join her shop, or stay free on the street? Comment shop, or street.
